description: Type avoidance beyond singletons (SPEC-GAPS §6): block-local vals in invariant positions and block-local classes/objects are packed existentially, as SLS §6.11 specifies.

termTypes.name: localValInvariant
termTypes.expr: { val X: Tree = new Tree; new Ref[X.type](X) }

termTypes.name: localClass
termTypes.expr: { class C extends Base; new C }

termTypes.name: localClassInvariant
termTypes.expr: { class C extends Base; new Ref(new C) }

termTypes.name: localClassThisType
termTypes.expr: { class C { def me: this.type = this }; new C().me }
